title: Comparative Study of the House Advancement Flap, Rhomboid Flap, and Y-V Anoplasty
brief_summary: This prospective randomized study included 60 consecutive patients suffering from anal stenosis in the period from April 2002 to December 2008. They admitted to colorectal surgery unit, Mansoura university hospital, Egypt. According to the classification proposed by Milson and Mazier(5), all patients had moderate to severe anal stenosis. There were 43 males and 17 female with a mean age 34 + 5.2 years ranging from 18 up to 63 years.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ALL PATIENTS with anal stenosis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant female
* Malignant stenosis
* Associated anal pathology
* Anal stenosis with a anal diameter more than 20 mm
